sloka: आश्रमं त्वृषिविरहितं प्रभु: क्षणमपि न विजहौ स राघव: ।राघवं हि सततमनुगतास्तापसाश्चार्षचरितधृतगुणा: ॥ २.११६.२६ ॥
transliteration: āśramaṁ tvṛṣivirahitaṁ prabhu: kṣaṇamapi na vijahau sa rāghava: ।rāghavaṁ hi satatamanugatāstāpasāścārṣacaritadhṛtaguṇā: ॥ 2.116.26 ॥

translations.english: Lord Rama, did not leave that hermitage deserted by the sages even for a moment. Those who had adopted the traditions of the sages and had acquired many virtues followed Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षोडशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredsixteenth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
